notes.formula: score = baseScore + adjustmentScore; each = sum(weight * (input - mean) / scale); delta follows base then adjustment order
notes.money: canonical v3 using reconciled terminal final SP, null when unavailable
notes.marketP: normalized over all terminal starters with valid final SP; rawMarketP = 1/decimal
notes.modelInputs: original frozen vectors, zero-fill interpreted using corresponding missing flags
notes.scope: latest complete frozen dataset through 20 November; no duplicate race ids
notes.favourite: minimum final SP, benchmark tie by runner ID
